Specification: This module defines a library of sequence-related operators that extend the standard Sequences module with conversions, search operations, prefix/suffix relations, folds, zipping/interleaving, and subsequence replacement utilities. It models no transition system and introduces no state variables; instead, it provides pure mathematical operators over sequences, sets, bags, and functions. The file includes helper constructions for converting between sets and sequences, computing common prefixes, flattening nested sequences, and performing first/all subsequence replacement, with comments emphasizing TLC and TLAPS compatibility decisions.

CASE Len(s) = Len(t) /\ Len(s) > 0 ->
        LET u[ i \in 1..Len(s) ] == 
                IF i = 1 THEN << <<s[i]>> >> \o << <<t[i]>> >>
                ELSE u[i-1] \o << <<s[i]>> >> \o << <<t[i]>> >>
        IN Last(u)
    [] Len(s) = Len(t) /\ Len(s) = 0 -> << <<>>, <<>> >>

CASE s = t -> r
    [] r = s -> t
    [] s # t /\ Len(s) = 0 ->
        LET z == Interleave([i \in 1..Len(t) |-> r], [i \in 1..Len(t) |-> <<t[i]>>])
        IN FlattenSeq(FlattenSeq(z))
    [] s # t /\ Len(s) > 0 /\ s \in SubSeqs(t) ->
        LET match(f) == { i \in 1..Len(f) : s = f[i] }
            comp(p, q) == \A i \in 1..Len(p) : p[i] <= q[i]
            R == BoundedSeq(BoundedSeq(Range(t), Len(t)), Len(t))
            S == { f \in R : FlattenSeq(f) = t }
            T == { f \in S : \A g \in S : 
                    Cardinality(match(g)) <= Cardinality(match(f)) }
            u == CHOOSE f \in T : 
                    \A g \in T : comp(
                        SetToSortSeq(match(f), <), SetToSortSeq(match(g), <))
        IN FlattenSeq([i \in 1..Len(u) |-> IF s = u[i] THEN r ELSE u[i]])
    [] OTHER -> t
